source_facts: A normal subcase may enlarge X0 arbitrarily with vertices from X, Y0, or Y while the seed is the separately controlled set S'.
For v outside S union X0, L_P(v) is {1,2,3,4} minus colors on N(v) intersect S; neighbors in X0 do not participate.
Axiom (v) classifies list-size 2 vertices into X and list-size 3 vertices into Y using L_{S,f}.
Lemma 10 explicitly recomputes Z_i from |L_{P'}(v)|=i and sets X=Z_2, Y=Z_3, X0 enlarged only by Z_1.
primary_sources.conclusion: A palette reduction caused only by colored X0 vertices is invisible to source L_P and is undone by source normalization as far as X/Y classification is concerned.

source_facts: Claims 14-16 construct polynomial families of subpalettes reducing the targeted 3-list vertices to list size at most 2.
Claim 15 can set every vertex of a set M of unbounded cardinality to a singleton color.
Claim 16 can set all vertices of a set W and an arbitrarily long prefix of N_z to singleton colors.
The subsequent palette updates propagate those singleton assignments to other vertices.
primary_sources.conclusion: The external algorithm's notion of a reduced list is a palette/update notion and need not be witnessed by bounded seed neighbors.

exact_bridge_question: Can the List-3 restriction family, without a new source-specific theorem, be represented as polynomially many CSZ normal subcases with bounded seed and arbitrary X0 so that every externally reduced competing 3-list survivor leaves source Y under axiom (v)?

localized_obstruction.name: X0_INVISIBILITY_TO_SOURCE_LIST
localized_obstruction.formula: For v notin S' union X0', L_{P'}(v) = [4] minus f'(N(v) intersect S'); colors on N(v) intersect X0' are ignored.
localized_obstruction.consequence: Moving bulk singleton-assigned vertices into X0' preserves extension constraints but does not reproduce the list deletions they cause in the external List-3 palette.
localized_obstruction.normalization_effect: If |L_{P'}(v)| remains 3, Lemma 10 places v in source Y even when the imported external palette has size at most 2.

illustrative_source_valid_family.edges: ab; a-y_j; x_j-y_j; y_j-z_j for every j; no other edges
properties: The graph is P6-free, hence P7-free.
It satisfies CSZ axioms (i)-(vi) with L_P(y_j)={2,3,4}.
Every actual extension must color y_j from {2,4} because x_j in X0 has color 3.
Nevertheless x_j does not affect L_P(y_j), so y_j remains a source 3-list vertex in Y.
illustrative_source_valid_family.role: Semantic witness only; it does not rule out additional source-specific transformations such as safe component deletion or a new bounded-witness theorem.

no_reinvention: Do not reprove the P7-free List-3 restriction theorem.
Do not treat external subpalette size as source L_P size.
Do not enlarge the seed by every bulk singleton vertex unless a seed-size bound is proved.
Do not claim impossibility of every conceivable source-specific compilation from this mismatch alone.
